title: Baked Arabian Chicken with Romano Cheese
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the flavors of Arabia, featuring chicken baked with a blend of spices and topped with a rich Romano cheese sauce.

ingredients.name: arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Season the chicken breasts with the arabian spice blend and pepper.
In a large baking dish, arrange the chicken breasts in a single layer.
Drizzle the zesty garlic sauce over the top of the chicken.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, combine the romano cheese and 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl.
Remove the chicken from the oven and top each breast with the romano cheese mixture.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
